title: Senator flags over 16M unused syringes for COVID vaccination with 2027 expiry
summary: Senator Raffy Tulfo rang the alarm over 16 million unused syringes worth P41.6 million at Tala Warehouse, originally meant for COVID-19 vaccination, which are set to expire in 2027.
